CATALOG.name: Helpers & discovery
CATALOG.blurb: Start here. These resolve your workspace by human-readable name so nothing downstream has to guess an ID.

tools.name: fc_get_groups_projects
tools.desc: Groups, projects and their apps keyed by readable name. The preferred first call in any conversation — call once, reuse the result.

tools.name: fc_fetch_current_session
tools.desc: The current user and session, including raw groups and projects. Call once at the start rather than repeatedly.

tools.name: fc_add_item_by_names
tools.desc: Add an item to an app inside a project by name instead of ID. Tasks are supported today.
rawParams: App name, e.g. Tasks, Discussions, Issue Tracker.
Title of the item to add.

tools.name: fc_add_comment_by_names
tools.desc: Comment on any item, naming the app instead of passing a numeric app_id.
rawParams: ID of the task, issue or discussion to comment on.

tools.name: fc_update_status
tools.desc: Update a task's status with a single call.
rawParams: ID of the task to update.
0 not started, 1 completed, 2 in progress, 3 invalid, 4 review.

Your bearer token expired or was rejected. Re-run the authorization flow: in Claude Desktop reconnect the connector under Settings → Connectors, in Claude Code run /mcp and choose Authenticate.

The authorization page checked your key and secret against the Freedcamp API and they did not match. Generate a fresh pair under Settings → API — the secret is only shown once, so a half-copied secret is the usual cause.
A name-based helper could not match that project. Names are matched exactly, including case — call fc_get_groups_projects and use the name it returns.

ERRORS.fix: The by-name shortcut currently creates Tasks only. Use the app's own tool — fc_add_discussion, fc_add_issue, fc_add_wiki — with the project_id from fc_get_groups_projects.

FAQ.q: Do I have to install or host anything?
FAQ.a: No. Point your client at https://mcp.freedcamp.com/mcp and authorize with your own Freedcamp API key and secret in the browser. There is nothing to download and nothing to keep running.

FAQ.q: Can my whole team use it?
FAQ.a: Yes — everyone points at the same endpoint and completes their own OAuth authorization with their own Freedcamp credentials. Each bearer token gets its own isolated handler, so sessions never mix.

FAQ.q: Can the AI see projects I do not have access to?
FAQ.a: No. Every call is signed with your own API credentials, so the server can only ever see and change what you can see and change in Freedcamp.

FAQ.q: Why does it keep telling me to call fc_get_groups_projects?
FAQ.a: Because almost every other tool needs a project_id, list_id or user_id, and that one call returns all of them keyed by readable name. The server's own instructions tell clients to fetch it once and reuse it.

FAQ.q: How do I create a subtask?
FAQ.a: Call fc_add_task with h_parent_id set to the parent task. The parent must live in the same list and cannot itself be a subtask.

FAQ.q: What is the difference between list_id and task_group_id?
FAQ.a: They are the same field. list_id is the current name, task_group_id is the legacy alias — send one, not both.

FAQ.q: Can I change many tasks at once?
FAQ.a: fc_batch_edit_tasks takes up to 500 task IDs and applies the same status, priority, assignees, dates, tags, custom fields, milestone or parent to all of them in one request.

FAQ.q: Is there a local or stdio version?
FAQ.a: Not at the moment — OAuth over the hosted HTTPS endpoint is the only supported transport, which is why there are no environment variables or npx commands anywhere in this guide.
